purpose: Teach: キャッチボール/プーチン/チャングム/ビクトリア/ヨコ/東海道/ゴア/ナビゲーション

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとキャッチボールに行ってらっしゃい
lines.en: Sho, go have fun playing catch with Dad.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Slight lift at the end. The casual certainty of a mother sending her son out to play. Natural, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプーチン政権のニュース見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the news about Putin's government.
lines.style: Bright, earnest voice. Quick pace, eager to share. A slight emphasis on 'we' — pride in the shared activity. Open and innocent in the telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチャングムのDVDを観られたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was able to watch that Jewel in the Palace DVD.
lines.style: Soft, knowing tone. Slight wonder underneath — noticing what her son and husband are doing together. Patient, warm observation. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとビクトリア女王の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Queen Victoria.
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery. Child's excitement bursting through. Eager to report another shared moment. Natural, unguarded enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヨコ書きの英語本も読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad has been reading those English books with horizontal text too.
lines.style: Quiet pleasure in her voice. Gentle notation — she's noticing and approving. Warm, almost to herself. A mother delighted by what's unfolding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと東海道線の旅したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I took a trip on the Tokaido Line together.
lines.style: Bright, quick-paced excitement. The satisfaction of a completed adventure. Eager to share this milestone. Natural child's voice, proud of the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴア元副大統領の環境本をご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad has even been looking at that book about Al Gore's environmental work.
lines.style: Soft, warm reflection. Slightly amazed at the scope of what her husband is exploring with their son. Tender observation. A quiet smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとナビゲーションのアプリ使ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I used a navigation app together.
lines.style: Bright, proud delivery. Quick, satisfied tone at the small-but-real accomplishment. Eager child voice, breathless slightly. Warm close to the conversation.
